sn47.8:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo rājānam vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nānāccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa ||
sn47.8:1.2: ambilaggehi pi tittakaggehi pi kaṭukaggehi pi madhuraggehi pi khārikehi pi akhārikehi pi loṇikehi pi aloṇikehi pi || || 4.
sn47.8:2.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattassa nimittaṃ na uggaṇhati ||
sn47.8:2.2: Idam vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati || imassa vā abhiharati || imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti || imassa vā vaṇṇam bhāsati || ||
sn47.8:2.3: Ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati || ambilaggassa vā abhiharati || ambilaggassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti || ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇam bhāsati || || Tittakaggaṃ vā me ajja Kaṭukaggaṃ vā me ajja || Madhuraggaṃ vā me ajja || Khārikaṃ vā me ajja || Akhārikaṃ vā me ajja || Loṇikaṃ vā me ajja || Aloṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati || aloṇikassa vā abhiharati || aloṇikassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇam bhāsatī ti || || 5.
sn47.8:3.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo na ceva lābhī hoti acchādanassa || na lābhī vetanassa na lābhī abhihārānaṃ ||
sn47.8:3.3: Tathā hi so bhikkhave bālo avyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattassa nimittaṃ na ugganhāti || || 6.
sn47.8:3.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bālo avyatto akusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.8:3.5: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati upakkilesā na pahiyyanti ||
sn47.8:3.9: Dhammesu dhammānupassi viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.8:3.10: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati upakkilesā na pahiyyanti ||
sn47.8:4.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave bālo avyatto akusalo bhikkhu na ceva lābhī diṭṭheva dhamme sukhavihārānaṃ || na lābhī satisampajaññassa ||
sn47.8:4.3: Tathā hi so bhikkhave bālo avyatto akusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti || || 8.
sn47.8:5.1: Seyyathāpi pi bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto kusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nānāccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa ||
sn47.8:5.2: ambilaggehi pi tittakaggehi pi kaṭukaggehi pi madhuraggehi pi khārikehi pi akhārikehi pi loṇikehi pi aloṇikehi pi || ||
sn47.8:6.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattassa nimittam uggaṇhāti ||
sn47.8:6.2: Idam vā me ajja bhattasupeyyaṃ ruccati || imassa vā abhiharati || imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti || imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati || ||
sn47.8:6.3: Ambilaggaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati ambilaggassa vā abhiharati || ambilaggassa vā bahum gaṇhāti || ambilaggassa vā vaṇṇam bhasati || Tittakaggaṃ vā ma ajja || Kaṭukaggaṃ vā me ajja || Madhuraggaṃ vā me ajja || Khārikaṃ vā me ajja || Akhārikaṃ vā me ajja || Loṇikaṃ vā me ajja || Aloṇikaṃ vā me ajja bhattasūpeyyaṃ ruccati || aloṇikassa vā abhiharati || aloṇikassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti || aloṇikassa vā vaṇṇam bhāsatī ti || || 9.
sn47.8:7.1: Sa kho bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto kusalo sūdo lābhī ceva hoti acchādanassa lābhī vetanassa lābhi abhihārānaṃ ||
sn47.8:7.3: Tathā hi so bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto kusalo sūdo sakassa bhattassa nimittam uggaṇhāti || || 10.
sn47.8:7.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco paṇḍito vyatto kusalo bhikkhu kāye kāyanupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.8:7.5: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati upakkilesā pahīyanti ||
sn47.8:7.9: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.8:7.10: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato cittaṃ samādhiyati upakkilesā pahīyanti ||
sn47.8:8.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto kusalo bhikkhu lābhī ceva hoti diṭṭheva dhamme sukhavihārānaṃ lābhī hoti satisampajaññassa ||
sn47.8:8.3: Tathā hi so bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto kusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittam uggaṇhātī ti || || 1.
